title: Security & Compliance review prep - 1:1 follow-up
content:
Purpose: follow-up notes after 1:1 prep for SOC2/ISO readiness and next steps for evidence collection.
Owner: Maya Thompson
Attendees (follow-up call): Maya, Aaron, Olivia, Sam, Priya (Legal)
Next auditor touchpoint: 2026-03-08 (confirmed)

Summary of status:
- Okta entitlement exports pulled (Aaron) but need redaction and canonical naming in evidence bucket.
- Datadog exports linked by Olivia; retention confirmation ok but need two example alerts tied to postmortems.
- KMS inventory compiled (Maya). Found 3 CMKs used by Dedicated; rotation logs show rotations in 2025 but need explicit rotation runbook and signed stamp.
- Change mgmt samples collected by Sam (5 PRs + deploys). Need to redact developer PII before uploading.
- Legal (Priya) working on vendor SOC2 collection; one vendor needs compensating control memo.

Decisions made in follow-up:
- Evidence will live in a single S3 prefix: s3://redwood-sec-evidence/prod/soc2/2026-q1/<owner-name>/ with read ACL only for audit team. Owners must follow filename pattern: <control>-<owner>-<yyyymmdd>-<artifact-type>.csv|pdf|md
- Redaction guidance: remove personal emails and incidental customer identifiers; preserve timestamps and identifiers that prove action. Priya to publish a 1-page redaction checklist.
- For KMS rotation proof, auditors prefer rotation logs + runbook. Maya to add a short note describing automated rotation and attach CloudTrail export for rotation events.

Open questions (to resolve before auditor call):
- Auditor acceptance of vendor attestations older than 12 months: Priya to confirm legal position and whether compensating controls memo acceptable.
- Scope question re: Dedicated customer-managed data plane: product asked if we can exclude customer-maintained VPCs; auditor to confirm if we still need network adjacency evidence.
- Sample size for change mgmt: auditor asked for 3-5 samples from last 6 months. Sam to flag 5 that show approvals + rollback evidence.

Action items (updated):
- Aaron Patel | due 2026-03-02 | Redact Okta entitlement exports and upload to evidence S3 prefix. Confirm file naming pattern.
- Olivia Chen | due 2026-03-02 | Upload Datadog retention proof + link 2 incident PMs. Attach sample alerts with timestamps and tracer ids.
- Maya Thompson | due 2026-03-03 | Upload KMS key inventory file + CloudTrail rotation exports + draft runbook (attach as markdown).
- Sam Lee | due 2026-03-03 | Sanitize and upload 5 change mgmt samples (PRs, approvals, deploy logs). Add short narrative for each sample.
- Priya Desai (Legal) | due 2026-03-04 | Deliver vendor SOC2 docs and redaction guidance memo; advise on older attestations.
- Schedule: evidence walkthrough with auditor prep meeting on 2026-03-05 (30m) - Maya to calendar invite.

Risks/Blockers updated:
- Two artifacts currently in personal Google Drive folders; owners to export to S3.
- One vendor still negotiating NDA before releasing SOC2. Legal escalated.
- Sprint freeze for infra team next week; propose pairing day to capture deploy logs.

Notes-to-self / reminders:
- Keep this doc informal; move completed items to Confluence checklist after upload.
- Add pointers to audit-friendly sample filenames in the runbook (example: accesscontrol-aaron-20260302-export.csv).
- After auditor call, capture any additional sample requests immediately in this doc and ping owners.

Recent changes: 2026-03-01 added follow-up decisions and S3 naming convention; 2026-03-03 updated action item due dates after sync.
